component.name: Screencap Documentation Tool
component.summary: Turn screen recordings into step-by-step screenshot documentation

description.p: Screencap Documentation Tool finds every step in a screen recording with FFmpeg scene detection and saves a screenshot of each one. Built with system administrators in mind, and useful for anyone who writes how-to guides.

ul.li: Presets for installers, the desktop, web consoles, terminals, remote desktops, and more
Review the steps: reorder, delete, crop, and write a caption for each one
Blur passwords, keys, and addresses automatically, with an unblurred copy kept
Export to HTML, Word, or PDF
Light and dark themes; everything runs locally, with no telemetry

description.p: The Windows installer can set the recordings and output folders; the snap is published to the Snap Store.
New winget package ID for Windows (no Linux changes).
The Windows installer updates an installed copy in place (no Linux changes).
Themed menu bar, a clearer About window and Advanced Settings window, and update status in the status bar.
Packages for Debian, Ubuntu, Fedora, openSUSE, Arch Linux, and the Snap Store.
